notes:
Fixed by the review run, then approved:
1. Dek: note said "Standards, card-network programs, bank trials and Singapore testing all point at one question: how an AI agent gets trusted to pay." The A*STAR/FFI source covers testing AI systems with finance firms and never mentions agents or payments. New: "Standards, card-network programs and a bank trial all point at one question: how an AI agent gets trusted to pay."
2. Last section: note said the four stories were "each aimed at agents that pay", same unsupported claim for the Singapore effort. Source: "A*STAR IAIC and FFI will test AI systems with the finance firms that take part." New: "...a standards call, a card-network program and a bank trial aimed at agents that pay, plus a regulator-linked effort to test AI with finance firms."
3. Section 4: "Meanwhile in Singapore" (checker flagged "meanwhile", no timing in source) became "In Singapore".
